record.label: Spectral amplification baseline for the low-energy window
record.statement: The authors adapt the published sum-of-squares spectral-amplification estimate to the low-energy window and include later compilation methods. They obtain a spacetime cost of about $1.09\times10^{12}$ qubit–T on 481 logical qubits.
record.boundary: With 481 logical qubits, 49,056 walk steps, 11,517 Toffolis per step and four T gates per Toffoli, the adjusted baseline has a cost of 1,087,017,579,648 qubit–T. The ratio to the proved upper bound of 436,509,499,221 is 2.49 to two decimal places. The published ground-state estimate corresponds to about $2.26\times10^{12}$ qubit–T.
